title: Nutty Roasted Jamaican Pork Hash
description: A roasted Jamaican dish featuring pul biber and served in individual mini cocottes, perfect for a brunch mood. It is satvik friendly and features a stone bowl dolsot style serving.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the diced pork, pul biber, scallions, coconut oil, ginger, garlic, thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Divide the mixture among 4 individual mini cocottes.
Roast the cocottes in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
Remove the cocottes from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the hash hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
Traditionally, the hash is served in a stone bowl dolsot style, but individual mini cocottes work just as well.
To add an extra layer of flavor, serve the hash with a fried egg on top.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F, then rest 3 minutes before serving.
